A sphere P, made of steel, has a weight of 10N on Earth.
Another sphere Q, also made of steel, has a weight of 10N on Mars.
The gravitational field strength on Earth is greater than the gravitational field strength on Mars.
Which statement is correct?
A
The mass of sphere P is the same as the mass of sphere Q.
B
The mass of sphere P is less than the mass of sphere Q.
C
On Mars, the weight of sphere P is the same as the weight of sphere Q.
D
On Earth, the weight of sphere Q is less than 10N.

options.label: A
options.text: The mass of sphere P is the same as the mass of sphere Q.
